result.description: Enterprise ecommerce platform (B2C Commerce, plus B2B Commerce) for storefronts, catalog, baskets, orders, customers and promotions.
result.auth_detail: B2C SCAPI Admin APIs: Account Manager API client with OAuth2 client_credentials only, JWT bearer token. Shopper APIs: separate SLAS (OAuth 2.1; public/private clients, PKCE guest or registered login). Legacy OCAPI also uses Account Manager tokens.
result.access_detail: No public signup or free tier found. Account Manager API clients and SLAS clients exist only inside a licensed customer org/realm. Sandboxes (on-demand) are provisioned within a customer realm. Credentials also need per-instance config (scopes, SLAS client, site IDs). Could not fetch the official pages (403) to confirm a free developer sandbox; none was found via search. Low confidence.
result.api_notes: B2C Commerce API (SCAPI): Shopper APIs (products, baskets, orders, customers, search, etc.) and Admin APIs (catalogs, products, inventory, promotions, orders, etc.), plus legacy OCAPI and Custom APIs. Per-tenant base URLs (short code, org ID). Separate B2B/D2C Commerce on Salesforce core has its own REST APIs.
result.blocker: No self-serve or free sandbox: credentials exist only inside a licensed B2C Commerce customer realm (Account Manager + per-instance setup). Official MCP (@salesforce/b2c-dx-mcp, developer preview) targets developer tooling, not store operations; community MCPs exist (brinzl/commercecloud-mcp-server, sfcc-dev-mcp).
